description: PW - GRID CONTROL — draws one value per tap for a Portland Weather placed immediately to its left, and those values take over the tap knobs for whichever destination is lit.

params.text: Steps through five ways the values respond to a shift: unlit, all move; then those at or below the pinned level are clamped to it, or left alone; then those at or above it, clamped or left alone.
Sets the level the values are pinned to and turned about, 0 to 100% of the range.
Turns the drawn values about the pinned level; at either extreme they come out inverted.
Sends the drawn values to the level of the 16 taps, 0 to 100%, replacing their level knobs.
Sends the drawn values to the panning of the 16 taps, full left to full right, replacing their pan knobs.
Sends the drawn values to the filter cutoff of the 16 taps, 15Hz to 8400Hz, replacing their Fc knobs.
Sends the drawn values to the filter resonance of the 16 taps, replacing their Q knobs.
Sends the drawn values to the pitch shift of the 16 taps, up to 24 semitones either way, replacing their pitch knobs.
Sends the drawn values to the detune of the 16 taps, up to 99 cents either way, replacing their detune knobs.

inputs.text: Shifts every drawn value up or down by a fifth of the full range per volt.
Shifts which tap reads which drawn value, moving the pattern along the 16 taps and wrapping round.
Moves the pinned level, 10% of the range per volt.
Turns the drawn values about the pinned level, 20% of the travel per volt.

notes: drag in the grid to set one value per tap. Several of these expanders can be chained, one per destination.
menu: All Maximum, All Minimum, All Half, Triangle, Sine, Ramp and Random — shapes drawn into the grid; these are on the grid display's own right-click menu, not the panel's.
Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Reduce By Half, Shift Left and Shift Right — changes to the shape already drawn; these are on the grid display's own right-click menu, not the panel's.
